messages.subject: Question about next GSoC topic
parts:
Dear R community member,

Hello, I am Yuki Ueda who is a developer of vscode-r.

I want to ask about your GSoC stance.
My project "vscode-r" has more than 200,000 installs,
and R user can edit R and other language files by the same editor.

However, I gave up to developing "vscode-r" for economic reasons.
Cause it, some user cannot get many feature functions (e.g. Plot,
environment, debug)

If this project can be next your GSoC topic, I can implement more good
functions for you.

Thank you to read my poor English.

Regards,


Yuki Ueda

Hello Yuki Ueda,

It is nice to hear from you. From your email it is not clear if you plan to apply as Mentor for GSoC 2019 under R, to further your project, or are you planning to apply as student and are looking for Mentors? Please explain.

Anyway we will know if R can participate in this years program only by end of February 2019. 

Regards,

Vijay
